column1: # Hand labels for test-video6 (club singles, 120-300 s of the source).
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Frame numbers are the ones burned into label-part-A.mp4 and label-part-B.mp4.
#   label-part-A.mp4   frames 0-5420, at a third speed      (4.6 min to watch)
#   label-part-B.mp4   frames 5370-10789, at a third speed  (4.6 min to watch)
# The two parts overlap by 50 frames on purpose, so nothing falls down the join.
# Both are the working video with a frame number burned on and nothing else: no boxes,
# no hit markers, no rally spans, no predictions. Label the whole clip, both parts.
# The camera is low and the near baseline is below the bottom of the frame. A near-player
# contact made with the player's feet or racket out of shot is still a contact: label it,
# and put "offscreen" in the note. Ignore the court on the left of the frame entirely.
# ONE LINE PER RACKET CONTACT
#     c  <frame>  <near|far|?>  [shot]  [note...]
#   frame   where the racket meets the shuttle. Within 3 or 4 frames is fine; the scorer
#           matches a prediction to a contact within 0.25 s, which is 15 frames here.
#   near    the player on this side of the net, nearer the camera.
#   far     the player beyond the net.
#   ?       you could not tell who hit it. Use it freely -- a contact with no hitter is
#           still scored for detection and is simply left out of the hitter figure, which
#           is better than a guess.
# ONE LINE PER CONTACT THAT IS REAL BUT NOT A RALLY SHOT
#     k  <frame>  <near|far|?>  [shot]  [note...]
#   Handing the shuttle back, a knock-up between points, a player bouncing it on their
#   racket. Real contacts, but not part of a rally, and scored as neither hit nor miss.
# ONE LINE PER RALLY
#     r  <start_frame>  <end_frame>  [note...]
#   Start at the serve contact. End where the shuttle comes to rest or play plainly stops.
#   Include every rally you see in either part of the video.
# THE SHOT FIELD IS OPTIONAL and is for the next milestone, not this one.
# If you want to save yourself watching this clip a second time later, add one of:
#     smash  drop  clear  lift  drive  net  serve  other  uncertain
# straight after the hitter. Nothing in the current scoring reads it. Leave it off and
# nothing is lost from this task.
# Example of the format, not of this clip:
#     c 120 near serve
#     c 151 far lift
#     c 188 near smash
#     k 940 near        returning the shuttle to the server
